h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pimpri Chinchwad

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Pimpri Chinchwad

items.pText: Pimpri Chinchwad grew around factories, and many of its residential areas started as housing for people working in the automobile and engineering units of Bhosari, Chinchwad and the nearby industrial belt. Today the city also has large new housing projects in Wakad, Ravet, Punawale and Moshi. FunPlay Systems supplies outdoor playground equipment to both, from our factory in Vasai East, about 130 km away.

We understand buyers who think like engineers, because we fabricate our own frames and roto-mould our own parts. Since 2002 we have built play equipment for schools, builders, companies and public bodies across India. For a Pimpri Chinchwad site, we send the equipment by road and install it with our team or a local dealer.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

attrs.className: fs-24 alt-font text-dark-gray d-block fw-600 ls-minus-1px mb-0

c: Designer, Manufacturer of Outdoor Play Equipment

Many company townships in and around the city have a central garden that has seen years of use. When the equipment needs replacing, the facility team usually wants pieces that are simple to maintain and easy to buy spares for. Galvanised frames and roto-moulded parts need only cleaning and periodic bolt checks.
Our
spring riders
, swings and see-saws suit these gardens, since they can be added one at a time as budget allows. We keep the full layout on one drawing so each new piece has its place and safe area planned.

richText.heading: New projects in Wakad, Ravet and Moshi

c: Builders in the western and northern parts of the city usually plan a play area beside the clubhouse or on the podium. A themed multi play station gives the brochure a strong picture and keeps children busy after possession. We use the self-standing method on podiums and grouting on open ground.
If your project is nearer the Pune side of the boundary, see our
Pune page
. The planning process is the same in both cities.

richText.heading: Choosing the surface under the equipment

c: The surface matters as much as the equipment. Packed earth turns hard in the dry months and muddy during the June to September rains. Grass wears away under swings and slides within a season.

Rubber flooring cushions falls, drains quickly and stays in shape, and we can supply it with the play equipment. If you prefer sand in one part of the garden, keep it to a defined pit with an edging, and plan to top it up after the monsoon.

Gardens run by the Pimpri Chinchwad Municipal Corporation see families every evening and on weekends. They need equipment that stays firm under heavy use, so we grout posts into concrete there. Merry-go-rounds and multi-seat swings take several children at once.
For walkers and senior citizens in the same garden, our
outdoor gym equipment in Pimpri Chinchwad
page covers exercise stations that can sit beside a play area.

items.q: Can we buy playground equipment in stages for our township?
items.a: Yes. We prepare one layout for the whole garden with the safe play area for every piece, and you can order part of it now and the rest later. Each new piece then fits without disturbing what is already installed.

items.q: Which surface should we use under the play equipment?
items.a: Rubber flooring is the most practical choice for most sites in Pimpri Chinchwad. It cushions falls, drains quickly in the rains and does not turn hard in summer. We can supply and lay it with the equipment.

items.q: How far is your factory from Pimpri Chinchwad?
items.a: Our factory is in Vasai East, Palghar district, about 130 km away. We make all the equipment there, send it by road and install it with our own team or a local dealer.

items.q: Are spare parts available after the warranty?
items.a: Yes. Contact our after sales team on +91 738 530 0921 with photos of the part. Springs, bearings and spare parts carry a one-year warranty, and after that the team can arrange replacements for you.
